title: Technology Sector Update for 02/07/2019: TWTR,TTWO,MRVL
text:

Technology stocks were falling in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing more than 1.8% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was dropping nearly 2.6%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Twitter ( TWTR ) slumped Thursday, sinking over 9%, after saying it would stop disclosing monthly active user numbers after the current quarter and said it expects Q1 revenue of between $715 million to $775 million for the three months ending March 31, compared with the Capital IQ projection of $768.7 million.
In other sector news:
(+) Take-Two Interactive Software ( TTWO ) rose 3.5% after MKM Partners said investors should buy the company's stock following Wednesday's near-14% decline, writing in a new research note that the slide was an overreaction to sub-par fiscal Q3 results and adding the company is executing well in a challenging but growing industry.
(-) Marvell Technology Group ( MRVL ) dropped 3% on Thursday after the integrated circuits company said it was expecting Q4 sales of between $735 million to $745 million, lagging its previously announced guidance range looking for $790 million to $830 million and also trailing the $810.68 million Capital IQ consensus.
